_comment: Rips Rumble. Ranked by total pack purchases, which is the sum of DEBIT rows in RipsWalletTransaction. A far bigger field than the Gauntlet: about 6,600 players over a week against 950.
_snapshot_comment: Row 2 of retool_db.gauntlet_standings. The same gauntlet-refresh workflow writes both rows in one run, so the Rumble costs no extra Retool workflow run.
title: Rips Rumble
headline: Rips
Rumble
_art_comment: Rips rains cards instead of leaves, because the board is about ripping packs. 'rain' means they keep coming without anyone touching the page; the pointer still sheds a trail on top of that. The cards are plain trading cards drawn by the raster engine, not any publisher's artwork or trade dress.
_absent_comment: Shown when a search finds nobody. Replaced automatically when the field is larger than the board, which is then the real reason.
absent: Players appear after their first Rips pack
_terms_comment: No qualifier: unlike the Gauntlet this counts every pack purchase, sweeps or not, which is what 'stake are total purchases of packs' means.
_window_comment: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD bounds, Eastern. Two days only.
_prizes_comment: The original Gauntlet ladder: 10,000 across 20 places. 'pool' is a checksum and the build aborts if the ladder does not sum to it.
_cap_comment: How many ranks the page lists, and so how many it can search. HARD CAP. Jordan, 2026-11-25: "I don't want more than 1000 it's a hard cap I don't want the public to know exactly how many enter". So nothing on the page may count or imply the size of the field: the Players tile shows the ranks listed, not the entrants, and the query must never carry a total back. Ranks past 1000 are off the board and cannot be searched for; that is the accepted trade.
_affiliate_comment: Affiliates are in, as on the Gauntlet since 2026-11-20. The Rips query has no affiliate clause at all.
_alias_comment: The table alias this board's query uses for the rows being counted. Only read when exclude_affiliates is true, to aim the Promotion sub-select at the right column.
_excluded_comment: Individuals kept out, as one-way digests rather than usernames because this repository is public. Generate one with: python3 build.py --exclude-key "thehandle"
_final_comment: Set true for the closing update. Changes the hero line to 'Final Standings as of'.
